<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl" translate="no" class="notranslate">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="google" content="notranslate" />
<meta http-equiv="Cache-Control" content="no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate" />
<meta http-equiv="Pragma" content="no-cache" />
<meta http-equiv="Expires" content="0" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent" />
<title>SewerPlan V61.1 — تجربة مباشرة على الآيفون</title>
<meta name="sewerplan-version" content="61.1">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0f172a;--panel:#111827;--panel2:#1f2937;--accent:#38bdf8;--text:#f8fafc;
    --muted:#94a3b8;--danger:#ef4444;--ok:#22c55e;--line:#243047;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{overscroll-behavior:none;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;}
  body{margin:0;font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);height:100vh;overflow:hidden;touch-action:pan-x pan-y}
  .app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:340px 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;height:100vh}
  header{grid-column:1/3;background:#020617;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 14px;gap:14px;min-height:112px}
  header h1{font-size:18px;margin:0}
  .status{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
  .headerBrand{min-width:150px}
  .toolbarStack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:1;min-width:0}
  .toolbar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
  .toolbarRow{background:#07101f;border:1px solid #1e2c42;border-radius:11px;padding:6px 8px}
  .toolbarRow.workToolbar{background:#091629;border-color:#28435f}
  .workToolbar button,.workToolbar .btn{padding:11px 15px;min-height:44px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
  .mainToolbar button,.mainToolbar .btn{padding:8px 11px;min-height:38px;font-size:12px}
  #infoBtn{border-color:#0ea5e9;background:#0c4a6e}
  #pdfBtn{background:#0f766e;border-color:#14b8a6;font-weight:700}
  #pdfBtn .actionIcon{color:#ccfbf1;font-size:11px;min-width:24px}
  button,.btn,input,select{font:inherit}
  button,.btn{background:#1e293b;color:#fff;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  button:hover,.btn:hover{border-color:#64748b;background:#273449}
  button.primary{background:#0369a1;border-color:#0284c7}
  button.danger{background:#7f1d1d;border-color:#991b1b}
  aside{background:var(--panel);border-left:1px solid #263244;padding:12px;overflow:auto}
  .section{background:#0b1220;border:1px solid #253148;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .section h3{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#e2e8f0}
  .row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:7px 0}
  .row>*{min-width:0}
  label{font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1}
  .field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;flex:1}
  input[type=number],input[type=text],select{
    background:#0f172a;color:#fff;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;width:100%
  }
  input[type=color]{background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;padding:3px;height:42px;width:100%}
  .libraryBrowser{display:grid;grid-template-columns:92px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;align-items:start}
  .categoryList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:sticky;top:0}
  .catBtn{background:#101a2c;border:1px solid #2d3d56;color:#cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 6px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center}
  .catBtn:hover{border-color:#64748b;background:#18253a}
  .catBtn.active{background:#075985;border-color:#0ea5e9;color:#fff}
  .lib{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;min-width:0}
  .fcard{background:#172033;border:1px solid #2b3a52;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;cursor:grab;text-align:center;user-select:none}
  .fcard:active{cursor:grabbing;transform:scale(.985)}
  .fcard:hover{border-color:#38bdf8}
  .ficon{display:block;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:4px}
  .fcard img{width:100%;height:70px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:0 auto 6px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.22))}
  .fcard b{display:block;font-size:13px}
  .fcard span{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8}
  main{position:relative;background:#334155;overflow:hidden;padding:14px}
  .mapPanel{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
  .mapTopbar{background:#081120;border:1px solid #233146;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
  .mapTopbar .group{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
  .mapTopbar .ctl{background:#0c1730;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 10px;color:#e5eefb;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .mapTopbar .ctl input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:#0ea5e9}
  .mapTopbar .zoomBox{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#0c1730;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 10px}
  .mapTopbar .miniBtn{background:#10203d;border:1px solid #37506e;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 10px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}
  .mapTopbar .miniBtn:hover{background:#16305a}
  .mapTopbar .miniBtn:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed;background:#10203d}
  .snapOn{color:#dff7ff}
  .mapTopbar .mapInfo{font-size:12px;color:#9fb4d1}
  .mapViewport{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#314761 0%,#293d55 52%,#223248 100%);border:1px solid #58708d;
  }
  .workspaceBrand{
    position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    z-index:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    pointer-events:none;user-select:none;opacity:.92;
    transition:opacity .2s ease;
  }
  .workspaceBrand svg{width:108px;height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.28))}
  .workspaceBrand .wbName{margin-top:8px;font:900 44px/1 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-2px}
  .workspaceBrand .wbName .furni{color:#f8fafc}
  .workspaceBrand .wbName .plan{color:#d39a39}
  .workspaceBrand .wbSub{margin-top:6px;color:#cbd5e1;font:700 11px/1.2 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:3px}
  .workspaceBrand .wbAr{margin-top:8px;color:#e2e8f0;font:700 14px/1.2 Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif}
  .mapViewport.has-plan .workspaceBrand{opacity:0}
  .canvasWrap{position:relative;z-index:1;border-radius:16px;overflow:scroll;padding:18px;direction:ltr;scrollbar-gutter:stable both-edges;cursor:default;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.035),inset 0 12px 32px rgba(2,6,23,.22),0 8px 24px rgba(2,6,23,.18);touch-action:pan-x pan-y}
  .mapViewport.pannable canvas{cursor:grab}
  .mapViewport.panning canvas{cursor:grabbing}
  .mapViewport.targeting canvas{cursor:none}
  .mapViewport.placing canvas{cursor:crosshair}
  .targetCursor{position:fixed;z-index:1200;width:24px;height:24px;border:1.3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.96);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;display:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.72),0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .targetCursor::before,.targetCursor::after{content:'';position:absolute;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}
  .targetCursor::before{left:-6px;right:-6px;top:50%;height:1px;transform:translateY(-50%)}
  .targetCursor::after{top:-6px;bottom:-6px;left:50%;width:1px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
  .targetCursor .dot{position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:50%;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
  .targetCursor .wand{display:none;position:absolute;left:50%;top:18px;width:5px;height:58px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:999px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid rgba(15,23,42,.85);box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
  .targetCursor .wand::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-14px;width:18px;height:18px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50%;background:#0ea5e9;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.9),0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
  .targetCursor.touchWand{width:30px;height:30px;border-width:2px}
  .targetCursor.touchWand .dot{width:7px;height:7px;background:#0ea5e9;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #111}
  .targetCursor.touchWand .wand{display:block}
  .targetCursor .liveMeasure{display:none;position:absolute;left:calc(100% + 10px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);color:#0f172a;border:1px solid rgba(14,165,233,.7);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px;font:700 13px/1 Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
  .targetCursor.touchWand .liveMeasure{left:calc(100% + 12px);top:24px;transform:none;font-size:14px;padding:5px 9px}
  .actionIcon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:18px;height:18px;margin-inline-start:0;margin-inline-end:6px;color:#38bdf8;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
  .mapLabelInspector{border-color:#36506d;background:#0b1422}
  .mapLabelValue{font-weight:bold;color:#e0f2fe;font-size:13px}
  .mapViewport::-webkit-scrollbar{height:15px;width:15px}
  .mapViewport::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#172033;border-radius:10px}
  .mapViewport::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#60748d;border:3px solid #172033;border-radius:10px}
  .mapViewport::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#7f96b1}
  .canvasWrap{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:flex-start;width:max-content;height:max-content;min-width:100%;min-height:100%;direction:ltr}
  .stage{position:relative;box-shadow:0 22px 58px rgba(2,6,23,.52),0 3px 12px rgba(2,6,23,.34);background:transparent;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:10px;margin:auto;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.42);touch-action:none}
  canvas{display:block;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;cursor:grab;image-rendering:auto}
  .hint{font-size:12px;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1.7}
  .badge{display:inline-block;background:#0f766e;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px}
  .badge.off{background:#475569}
  .small{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8}
  .footerNote{font-size:11px;color:#64748b;text-align:center;padding:4px 0 12px}
  .appRights{grid-column:1/3;grid-row:3;background:#020617;border-top:1px solid #1e293b;color:#cbd5e1;text-align:center;font-size:11px;padding:7px 12px;line-height:1.35;direction:rtl;z-index:20;min-height:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .palette{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
  .swatch{width:100%;height:26px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #475569;cursor:pointer}
  .twoCols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
  #fileInput,#loadInput,#dxfInput{display:none}
  .scrollHint{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;margin-top:6px}
  .modalOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(2,6,23,.72);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:1000}
  .modalCard{width:min(440px,calc(100vw - 30px));background:#0b1220;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5);padding:18px}
  .modalCard h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:17px}
  .modalCard p{font-size:12px;color:#a9b8cc;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 12px}
  .modalActions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}
  .modalActions button{flex:1}
  .measureBadge{font-size:11px;color:#dbeafe;background:#0f3a57;border:1px solid #1f6b96;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px}

  .bottomInspector{background:#081120;border:1px solid #233146;border-radius:14px;padding:9px 11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:58px;direction:rtl}
  .bottomInspector .selectedTitle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:150px;color:#dce8f7;font-size:12px}
  .bottomInspector .inlineField{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:#0c1730;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:9px;padding:5px 7px;font-size:11px;color:#b9c8dc}
  .bottomInspector .inlineField input[type=number]{width:72px;padding:6px}
  .bottomInspector .inlineField input[type=text]{width:135px;padding:6px}
  .bottomInspector .inlineField input[type=color]{width:44px;height:32px;padding:2px}
  .bottomInspector .bottomBtn{background:#10203d;border:1px solid #37506e;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px}
  .bottomInspector .bottomBtn.danger{background:#7f1d1d;border-color:#991b1b}
  .bottomInspector .mutedMsg{color:#8da2bd;font-size:12px}
  .measureInspector{border-color:#374151;background:#0a0f18}
  .measureValue{font-weight:bold;color:#f8fafc;font-size:13px}
  .measureHint{color:#9aa9bb;font-size:11px}

  .sectionTitleRow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
  .sectionTitleRow h3{margin:0}
  .libraryTools{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .libraryToolBtn{padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;border-radius:8px}
  .fcard{position:relative}
  .fcard .editLibBtn{position:absolute;top:5px;left:5px;width:28px;height:28px;padding:0;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(2,6,23,.84);border:1px solid #475569;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;z-index:3}
  .fcard .editLibBtn:hover{background:#075985;border-color:#38bdf8}
  .fcard .customMark{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;background:#0f766e;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 5px;font-size:9px;z-index:2}
  .genericThumb{width:100%;height:70px;margin:0 auto 6px;border-radius:8px;border:1px dashed #475569;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;color:#cbd5e1;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#273449,#111827)}
  .libraryModalCard{width:min(560px,calc(100vw - 30px))}
  .brandModalCard{width:min(590px,calc(100vw - 30px))}
  .brandPreview{height:150px;border:1px dashed #475569;border-radius:12px;background:#f8fafc;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px;padding:10px}
  .brandPreview img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
  .brandPreview .noImage{color:#64748b;font-size:12px}
  .libraryPreview{height:120px;border:1px dashed #475569;border-radius:12px;background:#111827;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}
  .libraryPreview img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
  .libraryPreview .noImage{font-size:12px;color:#64748b}
  .modalSubActions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .modalSubActions button{padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}


  .multiBadge{display:none;background:#0f766e;border:1px solid #14b8a6;color:#ecfeff;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold}
  .lockState{color:#fde68a}
  .layerCtl{border-style:dashed!important}

  .archGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.archGroupTitle{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#e2e8f0;background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 10px;text-align:center}.archCard{background:#172033;border:1px solid #2b3a52;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;cursor:grab;text-align:center;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start}.archCard:hover{border-color:#38bdf8}.archCard b{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#f8fafc;line-height:1.4}.archCard span{font-size:11px;color:#cbd5e1}.archThumbWrap{width:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:6px;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}.archThumb{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;background:#fff}.archIcon{display:none}.printMeta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.printMeta .wide{grid-column:1/3}.printNote{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1.6}.doorOnly{display:none}

  .displayState{color:#bfdbfe;border-style:dashed!important}
  .usedFurniturePanel{display:none;background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a;border:1px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:10px;padding:5px 7px;flex:0 0 auto;direction:rtl;max-height:108px;overflow:hidden}
  .usedFurnitureHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2}
  .usedFurnitureHead .small{color:#64748b;font-size:9px}
  .usedFurnitureGrid{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;padding:1px 1px 3px;direction:rtl;scrollbar-width:thin}
  .usedFurnitureCard{position:relative;flex:0 0 112px;height:78px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;padding:3px 5px 4px;text-align:center;direction:rtl}
  .usedFurnitureCard .ufName{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-bottom:1px;line-height:1.15}
  .usedFurnitureCard .ufThumb{height:38px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .usedFurnitureCard .ufThumb img{max-width:65px;max-height:34px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
  .usedFurnitureCard .ufThumb canvas{max-width:65px;max-height:34px;width:65px;height:34px;object-fit:contain;display:block}
  .usedFurnitureCard .ufGeneric{width:54px;height:30px;border:1px solid #64748b;border-radius:6px;display:block}
  .usedFurnitureCard .ufDims{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;color:#334155;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.1}
  .usedFurnitureCard .ufQty{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;background:#0f766e;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 4px;font-size:7.5px;font-weight:700}
  @media (hover:none) and (pointer:coarse) and (orientation:landscape){
    .usedFurniturePanel{max-height:92px;padding:4px 6px}
    .usedFurnitureHead{font-size:9.5px;margin-bottom:3px}
    .usedFurnitureHead .small{font-size:8px}
    .usedFurnitureCard{flex-basis:102px;height:67px;padding:3px 4px}
    .usedFurnitureCard .ufName{font-size:8.3px}
    .usedFurnitureCard .ufThumb{height:31px}
    .usedFurnitureCard .ufThumb img{max-width:56px;max-height:28px}
    .usedFurnitureCard .ufDims{font-size:7.3px;gap:4px}
    #selectedEmpty{min-height:34px!important;padding:4px 7px!important;border-radius:9px!important}
    #selectedEmpty .mutedMsg{font-size:9.5px!important;line-height:1.25;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%}
  }
  .ipadOnly{display:none}
  .sidebarScrim{display:none}
  .touchDragHandle{position:absolute;right:5px;bottom:5px;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(3,105,161,.92);border:1px solid #38bdf8;color:#fff;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:17px;font-weight:bold;z-index:4;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
  .touchDragGhost{position:fixed;z-index:4000;pointer-events:none;width:112px;min-height:94px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(8,17,32,.94);border:1px solid #38bdf8;box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.45);padding:8px;text-align:center;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);direction:rtl}
  .touchDragGhost img{width:90px;height:58px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:auto}
  .touchDragGhost b{font-size:11px;display:block;margin-top:3px}
  .touchDragGhost .archIcon{font-size:34px}
  .touchDropReady{outline:3px solid rgba(56,189,248,.9);outline-offset:-4px;background:#365475}
  .zoomStep{width:40px;min-width:40px;height:36px;padding:0;font-size:20px;line-height:1}
  @media (hover:none), (pointer:coarse){
    button,.btn,.catBtn,.mapTopbar .ctl,.mapTopbar .miniBtn{min-height:44px}
    input,select{min-height:42px}
    .fcard,.archCard{cursor:pointer}
    .touchDragHandle{display:flex}
    .fcard .editLibBtn{width:34px;height:34px}
    .mapTopbar .ctl{font-size:13px;padding:9px 11px}
    .bottomInspector .bottomBtn{min-height:42px}
  }
  @media(max-width:1180px){
    .app{grid-template-columns:300px 1fr}
    header{padding-inline:10px}
    .toolbarStack{max-width:calc(100vw - 170px)}
    .toolbar{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%;padding-bottom:4px;scrollbar-width:thin}
    .toolbar>*{flex:0 0 auto}
    .mainToolbar{gap:5px;overflow:visible;padding-inline:6px}
    .mainToolbar button,.mainToolbar .btn{padding:7px 8px;min-height:36px;font-size:11px}
    .mapTopbar{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;justify-content:flex-start;padding:8px}
    .mapTopbar .group{flex-wrap:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto}
    .bottomInspector{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;min-height:64px}
    .bottomInspector>*{flex:0 0 auto}
  }
  @media(max-width:900px){
    body{height:100dvh;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
    .app{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;height:calc(100dvh - env(safe-area-inset-top) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
    header{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;min-height:62px;height:auto;padding:7px 8px;align-items:center}
    .headerBrand{display:none}
    header h1{font-size:15px}
    .status{font-size:10px;max-width:160px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
    .toolbarStack{max-width:100%;width:100%;gap:5px}
    .toolbar{max-width:100%;gap:5px}
    .mainToolbar{overflow:visible;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:nowrap}
    .mainToolbar button,.mainToolbar .btn{padding:7px 7px;min-height:38px;font-size:11px}
    .workToolbar{overflow-x:auto;justify-content:flex-start}
    .workToolbar button,.workToolbar .btn{padding:9px 11px;min-height:42px;font-size:12px}
    .ipadOnly{display:inline-flex}
    aside{position:fixed;z-index:2500;right:0;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 112px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 30px);width:min(360px,88vw);border-left:1px solid #34435b;box-shadow:-18px 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transform:translateX(105%);transition:transform .22s ease;padding-bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
    aside.open{transform:translateX(0)}
    .sidebarScrim{position:fixed;z-index:2400;inset:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 112px) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom) 0;background:rgba(2,6,23,.48);display:none}
    .sidebarScrim.show{display:block}
    main{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;padding:8px;min-width:0;min-height:0}
    .appRights{grid-column:1;grid-row:3;font-size:10px;min-height:30px;padding:6px 8px}
    .mapPanel{gap:7px}
    .mapTopbar{border-radius:11px;padding:6px;gap:6px}
    .mapTopbar .ctl,.mapTopbar .miniBtn{font-size:11px;padding:7px 9px;min-height:40px}
    .mapTopbar .zoomBox{padding:4px 6px;min-height:40px}
    .mapTopbar .zoomBox input{width:118px!important}
    .mapViewport{border-radius:11px;padding:10px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
    .bottomInspector{border-radius:11px;padding:7px 8px;min-height:56px}
    .bottomInspector .inlineField input[type=number]{width:66px}
    .bottomInspector .inlineField input[type=text]{width:110px}
    .libraryBrowser{grid-template-columns:92px minmax(0,1fr)}
    .modalCard{max-height:82dvh;overflow:auto}
  }
  @media(max-width:600px){
    header>div:first-child{display:none}
    .toolbarStack{max-width:100vw;width:100%}
    .toolbar{max-width:100vw;width:100%}
    .mainToolbar{overflow-x:auto;justify-content:flex-start}
    aside{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 104px)}
    .sidebarScrim{inset:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 104px) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom) 0}
  }

/* ===== V54: stable two-bar layout, core V35 geometry untouched ===== */
header{
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:row!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:space-between!important;
  min-height:116px!important;
  padding:8px 12px!important;
  gap:10px!important;
  overflow:visible!important;
}
.headerBrand{
  flex:0 0 150px!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  text-align:right!important;
  align-self:center!important;
}
.headerBrand h1{font-size:27px!important;margin:0 0 5px!important;line-height:1!important}
.headerBrand .status{font-size:10px!important;max-width:145px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-overflow:ellipsis!important}
.toolbarStack{display:none!important}
#modernToolbarArea{
  flex:1 1 auto!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:column!important;
  gap:7px!important;
  direction:rtl!important;
}
#modernTopToolbar{
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:flex-start!important;
  gap:6px!important;
  flex-wrap:nowrap!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;scrollbar-width:none!important;
  padding:5px 6px!important;
  border:1px solid #303b4a!important;
  background:#11161c!important;
  border-radius:11px!important;
}
#modernTopToolbar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none!important}
#modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:5px!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;
  padding-inline-end:10px!important;margin-inline-end:4px!important;border-inline-end:1px solid #3d4855!important;
}
#modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup:first-child{padding-inline-start:0!important}
#modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup:last-child{border-inline-end:0!important;padding-inline-end:0!important;margin-inline-end:0!important}

.modernIconBtn{
  width:58px!important;height:56px!important;min-width:58px!important;min-height:56px!important;
  flex:0 0 58px!important;padding:4px 3px 3px!important;border-radius:10px!important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242b33,#171c22)!important;border:1px solid #46515d!important;
  color:#f3f6fa!important;display:inline-flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;
  gap:3px!important;position:relative!important;cursor:pointer!important;overflow:hidden!important
}
.modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:9.2px!important;line-height:1.05!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#d7e4f3!important;text-align:center!important;white-space:normal!important;max-width:100%!important;display:block!important;padding:0 2px!important}
.modernIconBtn .iconLabel.short{font-size:8.5px!important}
.modernIconBtn svg{flex:0 0 auto!important;margin-top:1px!important}
.modernIconBtn:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#303a44,#202730)!important;border-color:#7caee0!important}
.modernIconBtn.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#31516f,#21374c)!important;border-color:#79b2ea!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(121,178,234,.18)!important}
.modernIconBtn:disabled{opacity:.32!important;filter:saturate(.45)!important;cursor:not-allowed!important}
.modernIconBtn svg{width:27px!important;height:27px!important;display:block!important;fill:none!important;stroke:currentColor!important;stroke-width:1.8!important;stroke-linecap:round!important;stroke-linejoin:round!important;pointer-events:none!important}
.modernIconBtn.pdfIcon{color:#d9fff5!important}
.modernIconBtn.dangerIcon{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4d2227,#32171a)!important;border-color:#7b343d!important}
#modernSliderRow{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr 1fr!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  direction:rtl!important;
}
.modernSliderBox{
  height:38px!important;min-width:0!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:7px!important;
  padding:4px 8px!important;border:1px solid #304058!important;background:#0b1524!important;border-radius:10px!important;overflow:hidden!important
}
.modernSliderBox .sliderGlyph{width:21px!important;height:21px!important;min-width:21px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;color:#d9e8f7!important}
.modernSliderBox .sliderGlyph svg{width:20px!important;height:20px!important;fill:none!important;stroke:currentColor!important;stroke-width:1.8!important;stroke-linecap:round!important;stroke-linejoin:round!important}
.modernSliderBox input[type=range]{min-width:40px!important;flex:1 1 auto!important;width:auto!important}
.modernSliderBox .sliderValue{font-size:10px!important;color:#c7d2e0!important;min-width:34px!important;text-align:center!important;direction:ltr!important}
.modernSliderBox .zoomStep{width:30px!important;height:30px!important;min-width:30px!important;min-height:30px!important;padding:0!important;border-radius:7px!important;font-size:18px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important}
.mapTopbar{display:none!important}

main{position:relative!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar{
  position:absolute!important;z-index:80!important;
  left:8px!important;right:auto!important;inset-inline-start:auto!important;inset-inline-end:auto!important;
  top:8px!important;bottom:8px!important;
  display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;gap:4px!important;
  width:68px!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;
  padding:5px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,22,28,.98),rgba(10,15,21,.97))!important;
  border:1px solid #34414f!important;border-radius:11px!important;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.38)!important;
  direction:ltr!important;scrollbar-width:none!important
}
#furnitureIconToolbar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn{width:58px!important;height:56px!important;min-width:58px!important;min-height:56px!important;flex:0 0 58px!important;border-radius:10px!important;padding:4px 3px 3px!important;gap:3px!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn svg{width:27px!important;height:27px!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:9.2px!important;line-height:1.05!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar .toolSep{width:27px!important;height:1px!important;min-height:1px!important;background:#394654!important;margin:1px 0!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar .colorState::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:5px;right:5px;bottom:4px;height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--tool-color,#bfa781)}
#selectedPanel .bottomBtn,#selectedPanel #rotate90,#selectedPanel #rotate45,#selectedPanel #rotate180,#selectedPanel #rotate360,#selectedPanel #flipDoorBtn,#selectedPanel #lockItemBtn,#selectedPanel #dupBtn,#selectedPanel #deselectBtn,#selectedPanel #deleteBtn{display:none!important}

@media(max-width:1100px){
  header{min-height:108px!important;padding:7px 8px!important;gap:7px!important}
  .headerBrand{flex-basis:112px!important}.headerBrand h1{font-size:23px!important}.headerBrand .status{max-width:106px!important;font-size:9px!important}
  #modernTopToolbar{gap:4px!important;padding:4px!important}
  .modernIconBtn{width:52px!important;height:52px!important;min-width:52px!important;min-height:52px!important;flex-basis:52px!important}.modernIconBtn svg{width:21px!important;height:21px!important}.modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:8px!important}
  #modernSliderRow{gap:5px!important}.modernSliderBox{height:34px!important;padding:3px 5px!important;gap:4px!important}.modernSliderBox .sliderValue{font-size:8px!important;min-width:27px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar{left:6px!important;right:auto!important;width:60px!important;padding:4px!important;gap:3px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn{width:52px!important;height:52px!important;min-width:52px!important;min-height:52px!important;flex-basis:52px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn svg{width:21px!important;height:21px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:8px!important}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  header{min-height:96px!important;padding:5px!important;gap:4px!important}
  .headerBrand{flex-basis:64px!important}.headerBrand h1{font-size:18px!important}.headerBrand .status{display:none!important}
  .modernIconBtn{width:42px!important;height:46px!important;min-width:42px!important;min-height:46px!important;flex-basis:42px!important}.modernIconBtn svg{width:17px!important;height:17px!important}.modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:7px!important}
  #modernTopToolbar .secondaryTop{display:none!important}
  #modernSliderRow{gap:3px!important;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 1fr!important}
  .modernSliderBox{height:31px!important;padding:2px 4px!important}.modernSliderBox .sliderGlyph{display:none!important}.modernSliderBox .sliderValue{font-size:7px!important;min-width:24px!important}.modernSliderBox .zoomStep{width:25px!important;height:25px!important;min-width:25px!important;min-height:25px!important;font-size:15px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar{left:4px!important;right:auto!important;top:5px!important;bottom:5px!important;width:48px!important;padding:3px!important;gap:2px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn{width:42px!important;height:46px!important;min-width:42px!important;min-height:46px!important;flex-basis:42px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn svg{width:17px!important;height:17px!important}
  #furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:7px!important}
}


/* ===== V69: independent icon + icon-label size controls ===== */
:root{
  --tool-btn-w:87px;
  --tool-btn-h:84px;
  --tool-icon-size:41px;
  --tool-label-size:13.8px;
  --tool-label-short-size:12.8px;
  --tool-side-width:97px;
  --tool-header-h:148px;
}
header{min-height:var(--tool-header-h)!important}
.modernIconBtn{
  width:var(--tool-btn-w)!important;height:var(--tool-btn-h)!important;
  min-width:var(--tool-btn-w)!important;min-height:var(--tool-btn-h)!important;
  flex:0 0 var(--tool-btn-w)!important;
}
.modernIconBtn svg{
  width:var(--tool-icon-size)!important;height:var(--tool-icon-size)!important;
}
.modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:var(--tool-label-size)!important}
.modernIconBtn .iconLabel.short{font-size:var(--tool-label-short-size)!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar{
  width:var(--tool-side-width)!important;
}
#furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn{
  width:var(--tool-btn-w)!important;height:var(--tool-btn-h)!important;
  min-width:var(--tool-btn-w)!important;min-height:var(--tool-btn-h)!important;
  flex:0 0 var(--tool-btn-h)!important;
}
#furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn svg{
  width:var(--tool-icon-size)!important;height:var(--tool-icon-size)!important;
}
#furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn .iconLabel{font-size:var(--tool-label-size)!important}
#furnitureIconToolbar .modernIconBtn .iconLabel.short{font-size:var(--tool-label-short-size)!important}
#modernSliderRow{
  grid-template-columns:minmax(205px,1.25fr) repeat(4,minmax(145px,1fr))!important;
  overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-y:hidden!important;
  scrollbar-width:thin!important;padding-bottom:2px!important;
}
.modernSliderBox.uiScaleBox{min-width:145px!important}
.modernSliderBox .sliderCaption{
  font-size:9px!important;color:#d7e4f3!important;font-weight:700!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;
}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  #modernSliderRow{grid-template-columns:minmax(185px,1.2fr) repeat(4,minmax(132px,1fr))!important}
  .modernSliderBox.uiScaleBox{min-width:132px!important}
  .modernSliderBox .sliderCaption{font-size:8px!important}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  aside{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--tool-header-h))!important}
  .sidebarScrim{inset:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--tool-header-h)) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom) 0!important}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  #modernSliderRow{grid-template-columns:minmax(175px,1.15fr) repeat(4,minmax(122px,1fr))!important}
  .modernSliderBox.uiScaleBox{min-width:122px!important}
  .modernSliderBox .sliderCaption{font-size:7.5px!important}
}


/* V58 Assistant */
#assistantModal .modalCard{max-width:560px;position:relative}
.assistantHero{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111827,#172033);margin:8px 0 14px}
.assistantHeroIcon{width:54px;height:54px;min-width:54px;border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#dc2626;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(220,38,38,.24)}
.assistantHeroIcon svg{width:30px;height:30px;fill:currentColor;stroke:currentColor}
.assistantHeroText b{display:block;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:3px}.assistantHeroText span{font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1;line-height:1.6}
.assistantWatchBtn{width:100%;min-height:48px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:#b91c1c;border-color:#ef4444}
.assistantWatchBtn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.assistantState{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;text-align:center;margin-top:8px;min-height:18px}
.assistantAdminBtn{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;width:32px;height:32px;min-width:32px;padding:0;border-radius:9px;font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#0f172a;border:1px solid #475569;color:#cbd5e1}
.assistantAdminPanel{display:none;margin-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #334155;padding-top:12px}.assistantAdminPanel.open{display:block}
.assistantAdminPanel .assistantAdminHint{font-size:10.5px;color:#94a3b8;line-height:1.6;margin:6px 0 10px}.assistantAdminActions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}.assistantAdminActions button{flex:1;min-width:150px}
@media(max-width:700px){#assistantModal .modalCard{width:min(94vw,560px)}.assistantHeroIcon{width:46px;height:46px;min-width:46px}.assistantHeroText b{font-size:15px}.assistantHeroText span{font-size:11px}}


/* ===== V101 Fullscreen Furniture Library ===== */
.fullLibraryOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:5000;background:rgba(2,6,23,.98);display:none;color:#f8fafc;direction:rtl}
.fullLibraryOverlay.open{display:block}
.fullLibraryShell{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px minmax(0,1fr) 220px;grid-template-areas:"controls center cats";gap:10px;padding:10px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#07101f,#0b1220 45%,#07101f)}
.fullLibControls{grid-area:controls;background:#0b1424;border:1px solid #29405c;border-radius:16px;padding:12px;overflow:auto;direction:rtl}
.fullLibCenter{grid-area:center;display:grid;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(220px,1fr);gap:10px;min-width:0;min-height:0}
.fullLibCats{grid-area:cats;background:#0b1424;border:1px solid #29405c;border-radius:16px;padding:12px;overflow:auto}
.fullLibHeader{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.fullLibHeader h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}
.fullLibClose{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;font-size:22px;padding:0}
.fullLibSearch{width:100%;background:#07101f;color:#fff;border:1px solid #37506e;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.fullLibCatList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.fullLibCatBtn{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;text-align:right;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;background:#101a2c;border:1px solid #2d3d56}
.fullLibCatBtn.active{background:#075985;border-color:#38bdf8}
.fullLibCatBtn small{color:#94a3b8;font-size:10px}
.fullLibGridPanel{background:#0b1424;border:1px solid #29405c;border-radius:16px;padding:12px;overflow:auto;min-height:0}
.fullLibGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
.fullLibCard{position:relative;min-height:168px;background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a;border:3px solid transparent;border-radius:14px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px}
.fullLibCard:hover{border-color:#7dd3fc}.fullLibCard.selected{border-color:#0ea5e9;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(14,165,233,.22)}
.fullLibCard img{width:100%;height:112px;object-fit:contain;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.18))}
.fullLibGeneric{width:90px;height:75px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #94a3b8}
.fullLibCard b{font-size:12px;line-height:1.25;text-align:center}.fullLibCard span{font-size:10px;color:#64748b}
.fullLibPreviewPanel{position:relative;background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a;border:1px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;min-height:220px}
.fullLibPreviewTitle{position:absolute;z-index:2;top:10px;right:12px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.88);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px}
#fullLibPreviewCanvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.fullLibControlTitle{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#e0f2fe}
.fullLibControlGroup{border:1px solid #253b56;background:#08111f;border-radius:12px;padding:9px;margin-bottom:9px}
.fullLibControlGroup label{display:block;margin-bottom:5px;color:#cbd5e1}
.fullLibControlGroup input[type=text],.fullLibControlGroup input[type=number]{width:100%}
.fullLibTwo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.fullLibTools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.fullLibTools button{min-height:42px}
.fullLibLayerBtn.active{background:#075985;border-color:#38bdf8}
.fullLibChoose{width:100%;min-height:52px;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;background:#0284c7!important;border-color:#38bdf8!important}
.fullLibHint{font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#94a3b8;margin-top:8px}
#fullLibraryBtn{background:#075985;border-color:#38bdf8;font-weight:800}
#mobileFullLibraryBtn{display:none}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  #mobileFullLibraryBtn{
    display:inline-flex!important;position:fixed!important;
    right:10px!important;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--tool-header-h,96px) + 8px)!important;
    z-index:2200!important;min-width:88px!important;height:42px!important;min-height:42px!important;
    padding:7px 10px!important;border-radius:12px!important;
    background:#075985!important;border:1px solid #38bdf8!important;color:#fff!important;
    font:800 12px/1 Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif!important;
    align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
    box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(2,6,23,.42)!important;
  }
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  #mobileFullLibraryBtn{right:7px!important;min-width:78px!important;height:40px!important;min-height:40px!important;font-size:11px!important;padding:6px 8px!important}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
 .fullLibraryShell{grid-template-columns:170px minmax(0,1fr) 145px;gap:6px;padding:6px}
 .fullLibControls,.fullLibCats,.fullLibGridPanel{padding:7px;border-radius:12px}
 .fullLibCenter{grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(180px,1fr);gap:6px}
 .fullLibGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(118px,1fr));gap:7px}
 .fullLibCard{min-height:135px;padding:5px}.fullLibCard img{height:84px}.fullLibCatBtn{padding:8px 6px;font-size:10px}

@media(max-width:640px) and (orientation:portrait){

   grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);

   grid-template-areas:"cats" "center" "controls";

 }

 }

 .fullLibSearch{height:38px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:7px;font-size:13px}

 }

   grid-area:controls;display:grid;

 }

 }

 .fullLibHint{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0;font-size:9px;line-height:1.35;text-align:center}
}

<style id="v61DxfSnapStyle">
/* V61 DXF Vector Snap */
.targetCursor .dxfSnapTag{display:none;position:absolute;right:calc(100% + 9px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);white-space:nowrap;background:rgba(15,23,42,.95);color:#fff;border:1px solid #38bdf8;border-radius:8px;padding:4px 7px;font:700 11px/1.1 Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);direction:rtl}

.targetCursor.dxfSnapMidpoint .dot{background:#f59e0b!important}
.targetCursor.dxfSnapNearest .dot{background:#0ea5e9!important}

<style id="furniPlanSplashV87">
#fpSplash{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;overflow:hidden;
  background:#efe8df;opacity:1;visibility:visible;
  transition:opacity .78s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1),visibility .78s;
}
#fpSplash.fpSplashOut{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.fpSplashBg{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 14% 78%, rgba(189,135,72,.18) 0%, rgba(189,135,72,0) 24%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 84% 18%, rgba(208,160,96,.16) 0%, rgba(208,160,96,0) 22%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 78% 82%, rgba(34,34,34,.055) 0%, rgba(34,34,34,0) 20%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#f8f3ec 0%,#efe4d4 44%,#eadcc8 100%);
  filter:none;
  transform:none;
}
.fpSplashShade{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,
      rgba(255,248,239,.08) 0%,
      rgba(255,248,239,.26) 34%,
      rgba(255,248,239,.42) 50%,
      rgba(255,248,239,.22) 68%,
      rgba(255,248,239,.06) 100%);
}
.fpDecor{
  position:absolute;
  border-radius:50%;
  filter:blur(14px);
  opacity:.55;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.fpDecorLeft{
  width:300px;height:300px;left:-70px;bottom:-35px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(172,122,58,.24) 0%,rgba(172,122,58,.07) 46%,rgba(172,122,58,0) 74%);
}
.fpDecorRight{
  width:250px;height:250px;right:35px;top:70px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(52,52,52,.12) 0%,rgba(52,52,52,.04) 46%,rgba(52,52,52,0) 74%);
}
.fpDecorBottom{
  width:460px;height:130px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:22px;
  border-radius:42px;filter:blur(25px);
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,165,88,.20) 0%,rgba(212,165,88,.08) 48%,rgba(212,165,88,0) 76%);
}
.fpSplashContent{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:min(760px,60vw);min-height:72vh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:2vh 2.2vw 1.8vh;
  text-align:center;color:#171717;
  text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
}

.fpBrand{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:900;line-height:.92;font-size:clamp(54px,6.2vw,104px);letter-spacing:-.06em}
.fpBrand span{color:#111}.fpBrand b{color:#b97816}
.fpSub{margin-top:1.2vh;font:700 clamp(15px,1.45vw,28px)/1.1 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.24em}
.fpArabic{margin-top:1.4vh;font:700 clamp(18px,1.65vw,32px)/1.25 Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif}
.fpFeatures{
  width:min(760px,57vw);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);
  gap:0;margin-top:3.6vh;color:#111
}
.fpFeature{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.6vh;padding:0 .5vw;position:relative}
.fpFeature:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-1px;top:7%;height:70%;width:1px;background:rgba(176,118,35,.55)}
.fpFeature svg{width:clamp(30px,2.5vw,48px);height:auto}
.fpFeature span{font:700 clamp(11px,.95vw,18px)/1.15 Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}
.fpSplashTrack{
  margin-top:4vh;width:min(430px,32vw);height:14px;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;

}

.fpLoadingText{margin-top:1vh;font:500 clamp(12px,.9vw,16px)/1 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.42em;color:#343434}

<style>
/* SewerPlan V2 — dedicated drainage routing workspace */
:root{
  --sewer-navy:#0b2c4d;
  --sewer-blue:#1677c8;
  --sewer-sky:#59b8ff;
  --sewer-mist:#e8f5ff;
  --sewer-line:#c9e4f8;
  --sewer-ink:#102a43;
  --sewer-muted:#59738c;
  --sewer-success:#15a66b;
}

.sewerPlannerPanel{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid rgba(89,184,255,.62)!important;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0,rgba(89,184,255,.28),transparent 40%),
    linear-gradient(145deg,#f7fcff 0%,#e8f5ff 100%)!important;
  box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(11,44,77,.12);
}
.sewerPlannerPanel::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:auto -50px -72px auto;
  width:160px;
  height:160px;
  border:22px solid rgba(22,119,200,.10);
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.sewerPanelHeading{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}
.sewerPanelHeading h3{
  margin:0!important;
  color:var(--sewer-navy)!important;
  font-size:17px!important;
}
.sewerEyebrow{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:2px;
  color:#2476ae;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.14em;
}
.sewerLiveDot{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  width:11px;
  height:11px;
  margin:6px 2px 0 0;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#9fb9cc;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(159,185,204,.23);
  transition:.2s ease;
}
.sewerPlannerPanel.isDrawing .sewerLiveDot{
  background:#f59e0b;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(245,158,11,.20),0 0 18px rgba(245,158,11,.6);
}
.sewerPlannerPanel.hasRoutes .sewerLiveDot{
  background:var(--sewer-success);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(21,166,107,.18);
}
.sewerIntro{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  margin:0 0 10px!important;
  color:#355a78;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.55;
}
.sewerStepRail{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:0;
  margin:4px 7px 1px;
  direction:ltr;
}
.sewerStepRail span{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:20px;
  height:20px;
  border:2px solid #3992d3;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;
  color:#17649e;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.sewerStepRail i{
  flex:1;
  height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3992d3,#8bcaf5);
}
.sewerStepLabels{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  margin:0 1px 10px;
  color:#527490;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
  text-align:center;
}
.sewerFields{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:8px;
}
.sewerFields .field{
  color:#355a78;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.sewerFields select{
  width:100%;
  min-height:33px;
  margin-top:4px;
  border:1px solid #add8f5;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:#fff;
  color:var(--sewer-ink);
  font:700 12px Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;
}
.sewerToggle{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
  margin-top:8px;
  color:#274965;
  font-size:11px!important;
  font-weight:800;
}
.sewerToggle input{accent-color:#1677c8}
.sewerActions,.sewerSecondaryActions{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  display:grid;
  gap:7px;
  margin-top:11px;
}
.sewerActions{grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr}
.sewerSecondaryActions{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:7px}
.sewerPlannerPanel button{
  min-height:36px;
  padding:6px 8px;
  border-radius:9px;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.sewerPrimary{
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:#1264a7!important;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1478c7,#0b4f86)!important;
  box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(20,120,199,.25);
}
.sewerFinish{
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:#0a8257!important;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#14a56b,#087d53)!important;
}
.sewerPlannerPanel button:disabled{
  cursor:not-allowed;
  color:#7890a4!important;
  border-color:#d5e5f0!important;
  background:#edf4f8!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
.sewerVisibility{
  margin-top:10px;
  padding-top:8px;
  border-top:1px dashed #b8d9ee;
}
.sewerRouteInfo{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  min-height:39px;
  margin-top:9px;
  padding:8px 9px;
  border:1px solid #bfdef1;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
  color:#355a78;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:700;
  line-height:1.55;
}
.sewerRouteInfo strong{color:#0b548e}

/* Four direct controls in the upper toolbar: show/hide the pipe centre line
   and independently show/hide the elbow-angle labels. */
#modernTopToolbar .sewerTopTools{background:rgba(8,71,116,.06)!important}
#modernTopToolbar .sewerTopButton svg{stroke:#0b5f9d!important;stroke-width:1.8!important;fill:none!important}
#modernTopToolbar .sewerTopButton.active{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0d77bd,#0a4e81)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#0a4e81!important}
#modernTopToolbar .sewerTopButton.active svg{stroke:#fff!important}

#mainScroll.sewer-drawing,
#mainScroll.sewer-drawing canvas{
  cursor:crosshair!important;
  touch-action:none!important;
}
#mainScroll.sewer-drawing .canvasWrap{
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(22,119,200,.28),0 8px 24px rgba(2,6,23,.18)!important;
}
#mainScroll.sewer-drawing .stage{
  outline:3px solid rgba(89,184,255,.58);
  outline-offset:4px;
}

/* The secondary programme is deliberately limited to visual kitchen/bathroom aids. */
#sewerPlannerPanel ~ .section .libraryTools,
#sewerPlannerPanel ~ .section .editLibBtn{
  display:none!important;
}

@media(max-width:1180px){
  .sewerPlannerPanel{margin-bottom:8px!important}
  .sewerPlannerPanel button{min-height:42px;font-size:12px}
  .sewerFields select{min-height:38px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .sewerPlannerPanel{padding:11px!important;border-radius:12px!important}
  .sewerFields{gap:6px}
  .sewerFields select{font-size:11px}
  .sewerActions{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sewerSecondaryActions{gap:6px}
}

/* V4 contextual editing toolbar */
#sewerActionBar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%;padding:6px 3px;direction:rtl;flex-shrink:0;background:#e4eef7;border-radius:10px;box-sizing:border-box}
#sewerActionBar[hidden],#sewerPieceTools[hidden]{display:none!important}
#sewerActionBar button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-width:62px;min-height:58px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid #abc0d0;border-radius:9px;color:#16385b;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;padding:4px 9px;background:#fff;touch-action:manipulation}
#sewerActionBar button b{font-size:26px;line-height:1.1}
#sewerActionBar .sewerOk{background:#16a34a;color:white;border-color:#15803d}
#sewerActionBar .sewerCancel{background:#dc2626;color:white;border-color:#b91c1c}
#sewerActionBar .sewerEdit{background:#facc15;color:#292400;border-color:#eab308}
#sewerActionBar button.active{outline:3px solid #0b639e;outline-offset:-3px}
#sewerPieceTools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-shrink:0}
#sewerPieceTools label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;font-weight:900;color:#16385b;font-size:12px;gap:3px}
#sewerPieceTools select{min-width:70px;height:36px;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;background:white;color:#16385b;border:1px solid #abc0d0;border-radius:6px}
.sewerShadowControls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}
.sewerShadowControls label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#0b4f86}
.sewerShadowControls input{width:95px;accent-color:#0b77bd}
.sewerShadowControls button.active{background:#0b77bd!important;color:white!important}
#mainScroll.sewer-drawing canvas{touch-action:none!important}

/* V5 fixed compact left editing rail */
#sewerActionBar{position:fixed;left:7px;right:auto;top:120px;z-index:350;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;width:52px;max-width:52px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 160px);overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:4px;background:rgba(229,239,248,.95);border:1px solid #adc7dd;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #0002}
#sewerActionBar[hidden]{display:flex!important}
#sewerActionBar button{min-width:42px;width:42px;min-height:44px;height:44px;padding:3px 1px;gap:0;font-size:10px;border-radius:7px}
#sewerActionBar button b{font-size:23px;line-height:1.1}
#sewerActionBar button:disabled{opacity:.58}
#sewerPieceTools{flex-direction:column;gap:5px;border-top:1px solid #aac0d4;padding-top:5px}
#sewerPieceTools label{font-size:10px;gap:2px}
#sewerPieceTools select{min-width:42px;width:42px;height:31px;font-size:12px;padding:0;border-radius:5px}

/* V6 navy rail, always visible controls */
#sewerActionBar{width:47px;max-width:47px;padding:3px;gap:4px;background:#101d30!important;border-color:#29445e;max-height:calc(100dvh - 120px);scrollbar-width:none}
#sewerActionBar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#sewerActionBar button{width:39px;min-width:39px;height:39px;min-height:39px;background:#18324c!important;color:#f1f6fb!important;border-color:#355774;font-size:9px}
#sewerActionBar button b{font-size:21px}
#sewerActionBar .sewerEdit{background:#facc15!important;color:#302800!important;border-color:#dba90c}
#sewerActionBar .sewerOk:not(:disabled){background:#16a34a!important;color:white!important}
#sewerActionBar .sewerCancel:not(:disabled){background:#dc2626!important;color:white!important}
#sewerActionBar button:disabled{opacity:1;background:#132336!important;color:#526478!important;border-color:#263b50;box-shadow:none;outline:none}
#sewerActionBar button.active:not(.sewerEdit){background:#235e89!important;outline:2px solid #71b9ef}
#sewerPieceTools{display:flex!important;gap:4px;border-color:#355774;padding-top:4px}
#sewerActionBar .sewerAngle{font-size:15px;font-weight:900;height:30px;min-height:30px}
@media(max-height:600px){
 #sewerActionBar{width:86px;max-width:86px;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3px}
 #sewerActionEdit{grid-column:1 / -1;justify-self:center}
 #sewerPieceTools{grid-column:1 / -1;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3px}
 #sewerActionBar button{height:32px;min-height:32px}
 #sewerActionBar button b{font-size:18px}
 #sewerActionBar .sewerAngle{height:28px;min-height:28px}
}

/* Equal slider tracks, with visible icons on every screen size. */
#modernSliderRow{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;overflow-x:auto!important;gap:6px!important;}
#modernSliderRow .modernSliderBox{box-sizing:border-box!important;flex:0 0 224px!important;width:224px!important;min-width:224px!important;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:20px 20px 90px 20px 38px!important;gap:3px!important;padding:4px 6px!important;}
#modernSliderRow .sliderGlyph{display:flex!important;grid-column:1!important;grid-row:1!important;width:20px!important;min-width:20px!important;}
#modernSliderRow input[type=range]{grid-column:3!important;grid-row:1!important;width:90px!important;min-width:90px!important;max-width:90px!important;margin:0!important;}
#modernSliderRow .sliderValue{grid-column:5!important;grid-row:1!important;min-width:0!important;font-size:10px!important;}
#modernSliderRow .sliderCaption{display:none!important;}
#modernSliderRow #zoomOutBtn{grid-column:2!important;grid-row:1!important;}
#modernSliderRow #zoomInBtn{grid-column:4!important;grid-row:1!important;}
#modernSliderRow .zoomStep{width:20px!important;min-width:20px!important;}

.colorLayerTools svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.colorLayerTools{align-items:center;}
.colorLayerTools button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default;}
.colorLayerTools button.active{background:#155e75!important;border-color:#38bdf8!important;}
.colorLayerTools select{max-width:140px;background:#10243a;color:#e2e8f0;border:1px solid #475569;border-radius:6px;padding:6px;font-size:12px;}
.layerColorPicker{width:35px;height:35px;padding:2px;background:#10243a;border:1px solid #64748b;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;}
#colorConfirm{color:#4ade80;}#colorCancel{color:#f87171;}

html body #modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup{border:1px solid var(--group-border,#64748b)!important;border-radius:10px!important;background:var(--group-bg,#172435)!important;padding:5px!important;gap:4px!important;margin:2px!important;}
/* Alternate only the existing interface background shades. */
#modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup{--group-border:#64748b;}
#modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup:nth-child(odd){--group-bg:var(--panel2,#1f2937);}
#modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup:nth-child(even){--group-bg:#11161c;}
#modernSliderRow input[type=range]{touch-action:none!important;}

/* Each vertical surface owns its right-hand scrollbar; Arabic content stays RTL. */
html body .app > aside{
 direction:ltr!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;
 min-height:0;scrollbar-gutter:stable!important;
}
html body .app > aside > *{direction:rtl;}
html body #mainScroll.mapViewport{
 direction:ltr!important;overflow:auto!important;scrollbar-gutter:stable!important;
 min-height:0;overscroll-behavior:contain;
}
html body #furnitureIconToolbar,html body #sewerActionBar{
 direction:ltr!important;scrollbar-width:auto!important;scrollbar-gutter:stable;
 overscroll-behavior:contain;
}
html body #sewerActionBar{width:66px;max-width:66px;}
html body #sewerActionBar > *{direction:rtl;}
html body .app > aside,html body #furnitureIconToolbar,
html body #sewerActionBar,html body #mainScroll{
 scrollbar-color:#64748b #111827!important;scrollbar-width:auto!important;
}
html body .app > aside::-webkit-scrollbar,
html body #furnitureIconToolbar::-webkit-scrollbar,
html body #sewerActionBar::-webkit-scrollbar,
html body #mainScroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:block!important;width:12px!important;height:12px!important;}
html body .app > aside::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
html body #furnitureIconToolbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
html body #sewerActionBar::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
html body #mainScroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#111827;}
html body .app > aside::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
html body #furnitureIconToolbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
html body #sewerActionBar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
html body #mainScroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#64748b;border:3px solid #111827;border-radius:9px;}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
 html body #furnitureIconToolbar{width:calc(var(--tool-side-width,97px) + 14px)!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;}
}

/* V18 grouped catalogue: collapsed until explicitly opened. */
html body .sewerLibraryBrowser{display:block!important;}
html body .sewerLibraryBrowser > #categoryList{display:none!important;}
html body #library.sewerGroupedLibrary{display:block!important;}
.sewerLibrarySection{margin:8px 0;border:1px solid #475569;border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel,#111827);overflow:hidden;}
.sewerLibrarySection > summary{padding:12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--text,#f8fafc);background:var(--panel2,#1f2937);}
.sewerLibrarySection > summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #94a3b8;outline-offset:-3px;}
.sewerLibraryCards{padding:8px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;}

/* V19: group panels alternate; every button keeps one shared neutral surface. */
html body #modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup{
 padding:9px!important;gap:5px!important;border:1px solid #94a3b8!important;
 background:#11161c!important;border-radius:9px!important;
}
html body #modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup.sewerGroupLight{background:#334155!important;}
html body #modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup.sewerGroupDark{background:#11161c!important;}
html body #modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup .modernIconBtn{
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242b33,#171c22)!important;
 border:1px solid #64748b!important;border-radius:8px!important;
 box-shadow:none!important;
}
html body #modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup .modernIconBtn:hover{
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,#303a44,#202730)!important;
 border-color:#cbd5e1!important;
}
html body #modernTopToolbar .topToolGroup .modernIconBtn.active{
 border-color:#cbd5e1!important;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 #94a3b8!important;
}
#sewerArchitectureSection .archGrid{padding:8px;}
#sewerArchitectureSection .hint{padding:8px 10px 0;}

/* Superseded controls shown in the supplied reference; pipe summary remains visible. */
#sewerPlannerPanel .sewerSecondaryActions,
#sewerPlannerPanel .sewerVisibility{display:none!important;}
.sewerLibrarySection > .sewerLibrarySection{margin:8px;}

/* Keep catalogue and placed 45-degree fittings at the same neutral PVC brightness. */
img[src*="assets/sanitary/part-08.png"]{filter:brightness(1.08);}

/* Compact route colour chooser beside the drawing controls. */
.sewerRouteColor{grid-column:1/-1;direction:rtl;border:1px solid #b7cedf;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;color:#23445b;padding:7px 9px;min-width:0}
.sewerRouteColor summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;list-style:none}
.sewerRouteColor summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.sewerColorDot{display:inline-block;width:23px;height:23px;border:1px solid #7892a5;border-radius:5px;background:#fff}
.sewerColorChoices{padding-top:9px}
.sewerCustomColor{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer}
.sewerCustomColor input{width:46px;height:30px;padding:0;border:1px solid #8ca7ba;border-radius:4px;background:transparent}
.sewerColorSwatches{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.sewerColorSwatches button{aspect-ratio:1;min-width:0;min-height:32px;padding:0;border:1px solid #8ca7ba;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer}
.sewerColorSwatches button[aria-pressed="true"]{outline:2px solid #0f172a;outline-offset:2px}

/* Editing colours use the same palette beside the narrow action rail. */
#sewerActionColor[hidden],#sewerEditColorPanel[hidden]{display:none!important}
#sewerActionBar #sewerActionColor b{width:20px;height:17px;min-height:17px;margin-bottom:3px}
#sewerEditColorPanel{position:fixed;z-index:360;width:210px;max-width:calc(100vw - 95px);box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px;background:#fff;color:#23445b;border:1px solid #8ca7ba;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0003;direction:rtl}

.sewerOutlineControls{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;padding:3px 7px;border-inline-start:1px solid #355774;min-width:105px;color:#e5edf5}
.sewerOutlineControls label{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:3px;font-size:11px;max-width:110px}
.sewerOutlineControls input{width:100%;margin:0;accent-color:#38bdf8}
#sewerEditOutline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:50px;color:#e5edf5;font-size:10px;gap:3px;padding:6px 0}
#sewerEditOutline[hidden]{display:none!important}
#sewerEditOutline input{width:48px;accent-color:#38bdf8;margin:0}
#sewerEditOutline input:disabled{opacity:.3}

.sewerCreationOutline{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #bfd2e0;border-radius:8px;margin:6px 0;direction:rtl}
.sewerCreationOutline>label:last-child{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:12px}
.sewerCreationOutline input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:#258aca}
#sewerEditOutlineButton[hidden]{display:none!important}
#sewerEditOutline{position:fixed;z-index:365;width:240px;max-width:calc(100vw - 85px);box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px;background:#132c45;border:1px solid #527591;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #0003;font-size:13px;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
#sewerEditOutline input{width:100%;height:24px}

#sewerEditOutline .sewerEnableGroupOutline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;width:100%;font-size:12px}
#sewerEditOutline input[type=checkbox]{width:17px;height:17px;flex-shrink:0}

.sewerOpacityLayer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-shrink:0;min-width:300px;padding:3px 8px;border:1px solid #355774;border-radius:9px;color:#e5edf5;direction:rtl}
.sewerOpacityLayer select{background:#18324c;color:white;border:1px solid #58728b;border-radius:5px;padding:3px;max-width:100px}
.sewerOpacityLayer label{font-size:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.sewerOpacityLayer input{width:95px;accent-color:#38bdf8}
#sewerItemTransparencyTool{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:6px 3px;color:#e5edf5;background:#18324c;border:1px solid #58728b;border-radius:7px;flex-shrink:0}
#sewerItemTransparencyTool label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px}
#sewerItemTransparencyTool input{width:100%;min-width:0;accent-color:#38bdf8}
#sewerItemTransparencyTool input:disabled{opacity:.35}

.sewerLibraryLayerBox{display:block;grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid #557694;border-radius:10px;padding:8px;margin:4px 0 12px;background:#10243a}
.sewerLibraryLayerBox>h3{margin:0 0 8px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:#214666;color:#fff;font-size:15px;text-align:right}


/* Desktop rail uses the entire available viewport height. */
html:not(.sewer-mobile-device) body #sewerActionBar{bottom:32px!important;height:auto!important;max-height:none!important;overflow-y:auto!important;align-items:center;}
html:not(.sewer-mobile-device) body #sewerActionBar>*{flex-shrink:0!important;}
html:not(.sewer-mobile-device) body #sewerPieceTools{flex:0 0 auto!important;}

</style>

<style id="furniplan-scroll-slider-v92">
:root{
  --fp-scroll-track:#4b627d;
  --fp-scroll-track2:#3f566f;
  --fp-scroll-border:#647f9d;
  --fp-scroll-thumb:#8ba7c7;
  --fp-scroll-thumb2:#7392b6;
}

/* Scrollbars: remove white tracks and keep the blue visual language */
*{
  scrollbar-color:var(--fp-scroll-thumb2) var(--fp-scroll-track2);
  scrollbar-width:auto;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar{
  width:14px;
  height:14px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--fp-scroll-track),var(--fp-scroll-track2));
  border:1px solid var(--fp-scroll-border);
  border-radius:999px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--fp-scroll-thumb),var(--fp-scroll-thumb2));
  border:2px solid var(--fp-scroll-track2);
  border-radius:999px;
  min-height:34px;
  min-width:34px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#9fb8d4,#809fbe);
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-corner{
  background:#3f566f;
}

/* Main plan viewport scrollbars */
#mainScroll{
  scrollbar-color:#7696ba #425a74;
}
#mainScroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track{
  background:#425a74;
  border-color:#5f7895;
}
#mainScroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#91accb,#7292b6);
  border-color:#425a74;
}

/* Top toolbar range sliders */
input[type="range"]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;
  appearance:none;
  background:transparent!important;
  accent-color:#86a7ca;
}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  height:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#506985,#435c76);
  border:1px solid #69839f;
  border-radius:999px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;
  appearance:none;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  margin-top:-5px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a5bfd8,#7e9fc0);
  border:2px solid #d6e2ee;
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track{
  height:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#506985,#435c76);
  border:1px solid #69839f;
  border-radius:999px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a5bfd8,#7e9fc0);
  border:2px solid #d6e2ee;
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}

/* Keep the slider containers in the same blue family */
.mapTopbar .zoomBox,
.toolbarRow .zoomBox{
  background:#324a64!important;
  border-color:#607a97!important;
}
</style>


<style id="furniplan-v94-layout-toolbar">
/* Keep map strictly inside its own area */
.mapPanel{
  height:100%;
  min-height:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:10px;
}
.mapViewport{
  position:relative;
  flex:1 1 0;
  min-height:0;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
.canvasWrap{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
